I have a few qualms with this unit. It’s absolutely not 18 inches to begin. Closer to 14 which is a crazy big difference. It seems to be full of flyaways and split ends. The density is pretty thin as well. It’s absolutely not worth $180 by any means. I had to do some plucking and blending to make it look natural and because of its low density and split ends, it just doesn’t style very well. I wish I had gotten a better product for what I paid for.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently describe the hair as very soft.
Many say the wig is true to length and full, though a few report it runs short and thin.
Several reviewers note minimal to no shedding and little to no smell.
Some mention the cap runs small and the lace is too light for women of color, requiring extra work.
Buyers often call it a great value and say they would order again.
